topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The walls feel closer today, the air thinner. My steps are lighter, yet my chest is heavy. Another door, another set of faces, all smiles and welcoming nods. I can't help but wonder what shadows this new light will reveal. They tell me it's a step forward, a new chapter, but the pages seem unturned, daunting. Everyone seems so certain, their paths clear, their voices steady. I carry my things, my thoughts, my silent questions, and place them all in this new space. The room is bright, too bright, and I search for a corner to settle, to observe, to understand how I fit into this painted optimism.
